summary: Swipedia v2 full-stack test: backend pytest 22/22 PASS, frontend Playwright all 19 steps PASS. Verified: decimal difficulty points (kolay=0.10 earned, accumulates 0.1->0.6->0.85->1.85 as float across zor/orta/uzman, persisted via /auth/me), invalid difficulty 422, question create with difficulty+background persists to feed, real Emergent Object Storage upload (1x1 PNG -> path -> GET /api/files/{path}?token= returns exact bytes, 401 without/invalid token), conversations other_name computed from OTHER participant on both sides (perspective bug fix confirmed). Frontend: guest login -> rank-badge (Vatandaş + puan, top-left) + feed-messages-button (top-right), old 0/25 pill GONE, correct answer -> answer-feedback 'Bildin!' + points-popup '+0.1 puan / 1/50 doğru · Toplam 0.1 puan' visible then slides away after ~3.5s (y=846), 2x2 option grid confirmed via bounding boxes (opt0/opt1 same row), author avatar circle + @name on cards, custom tab bar order [Oluştur, Rütbeler, Keşfet(raised center), Mesaj, Profil] all navigate, ranks screen with current-rank-card + 6 rank rows + Buradasın chip on citizen, rank-badge taps to ranks, create screen difficulty chips + background tiles (Klasik/preset-0..3/Yükle), publish with zor+preset-0 -> new question first in feed WITH rendered image background + dark scrim (screenshot verified), profile rank chip + decimal points + x/50 progress card, email login swipedia-test@example.com/secret123 works, chat send/receive end-to-end works with correct other_name in inbox. react_native_issues.issue: React Native Web deprecation warnings in console: 'shadow* style props are deprecated. Use boxShadow' (index.tsx:456, custom-tab-bar.tsx:97) and 'props.pointerEvents is deprecated. Use style.pointerEvents' (index.tsx:241 header View). Non-breaking on web preview but should be migrated for future RN versions.
Citizen rank range label reads '1-50 puan' but min is 0 — a 0-puan user IS Vatandaş while the row implies rank starts at 1. Reference: /app/frontend/src/ranks.ts:15

critical_code_review_comments: server.py (576 lines) clean: Pydantic validation, invalid difficulty -> explicit 422, no _id leakage, env-only config, decimal points rounded to 2dp with float-safe accumulation, answer idempotency via answer_key.
GET /api/files/{path} correctly accepts token via query param (web can't send headers) and validates session expiry.
frontend api.ts uses Constants.expoConfig.extra.backendUrl || process.env.EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL — no hardcoded URLs.
All interactive elements have testID; StyleSheet.create used throughout; all text wrapped in Text; FlatList virtualization fine on web.
CardBackground correctly distinguishes remote http backgrounds vs storage paths (resolves via fileUrl with token).

Feed sorts newest-first, so TEST_* questions appear at top; TEST puan questions always have correct option 0 ('Doğru'). rca_of_issue: No bugs found this iteration. Only test-side fixes: multipart upload test needed no JSON Content-Type header (else FastAPI 422 'Field required'), and xdist class-attr sharing was refactored into a single self-contained upload test.
